upi_fraud.name: UPI Payment Fraud
patterns: QR code scam where merchant requests payment instead of receiving
Fake UPI collect request disguised as refund
Request to share UPI PIN for 'verification'
VPA address that looks like official but is impersonation
Auto-pay mandate fraud through social engineering
red_flags: Sharing QR code to receive money
Fake bank representative calling for OTP
Requests to install remote access apps
typical_messages: Your UPI payment of ₹{amount} has been initiated. Call {number} to cancel.
Congratulations! You've won ₹{amount}. Share your UPI ID to receive.
Bank verification needed. Share your UPI PIN to keep account active.

investment_scam.name: Fake Investment Scheme
patterns: Guaranteed high returns with no risk promises
Crypto trading bot that promises daily profits
Forex trading with guaranteed returns
Ponzi/pyramid scheme recruitment messages
Fake IPO allocation or pre-IPO shares
red_flags: Double your money in X days
typical_messages: Invest ₹{amount} and get ₹{amount2} in 24 hours guaranteed!
Our AI trading bot made ₹{amount} profit yesterday. Join now!
Last chance to buy pre-IPO shares at 50% discount!

phishing.name: Bank/Phishing Scam
patterns: Fake bank SMS asking to verify account
Email pretending to be from bank with urgent action needed
Fake KYC update link that steals credentials
Government tax refund phishing
Fake insurance policy renewal
typical_messages: Your {bank} account will be deactivated. Click {link} to update KYC immediately.
Alert: Unauthorized transaction of ₹{amount} from your account. Call {number} to block.
Income Tax refund of ₹{amount} pending. Claim now at {link}

otp_fraud.name: OTP/Verification Fraud
patterns: Request to share OTP received on phone
Fake customer care asking for verification code
Social media account takeover via OTP
E-commerce order cancellation requiring OTP share
red_flags: Share the OTP you just received
I'll send you a code, please forward it
Don't tell anyone about this call

loan_scam.name: Fake Loan Scam
patterns: Guaranteed loan approval with no documents
Loan processing fee required upfront
Instant loan apps that steal data
Fake government subsidy schemes
red_flags: Install this app for instant loan

job_scam.name: Fake Job/Earning Scam
patterns: Work from home with unrealistic pay
Data entry job requiring registration fee
Part-time job asking for bank details upfront
Reselling/referral scheme disguised as job

digital_arrest.name: Digital Arrest Scam
patterns: Fake police/CBI officer on video call
Claims of involvement in money laundering
Kept on video call for hours under threat
Asked to transfer money to 'safe account' for verification
red_flags: Don't tell anyone about this investigation
Your involvement in money laundering case

social_engineering.name: Social Engineering/Impersonation
patterns: Impersonating friend/family in emergency
Fake customer support on social media
Romance scam leading to financial requests
Tech support scam requesting remote access
red_flags: I'm in trouble, send money urgently
My phone broke, this is my new number

safe_indicators: Standard transactional message from known sender
Informational message without call to action
